relationships.subject: Cannabis
relationships.evidence_quote: Cannabis contains over 100 phytocannabinoids, chiefly psychoactive Δ9-THC and nonpsychoactive cannabidiol (CBD), which act on cannabinoid type-1 (CB1) and type-2 (CB2) receptors.

relationships.subject: Cannabis
relationships.evidence_quote: Chronic use downregulates CB1 signaling, contributing to tolerance, dependence, and withdrawal.

key_findings: Review of cannabis pharmacology and perioperative anesthetic considerations; cannabis use is associated with increased propofol requirements.
